description: The Allgauer Moorallianz initiative restores and protects bog and fen habitats through cooperation with landowners and local organisations. The case relates landscape conservation to climate regulation and continued ecosystem services. The resource is documented by European Environment Agency, Climate-ADAPT (case-study publisher). The application is located in Allgau. This is a narrative case, not a regularly gridded or periodically sampled dataset; intervention dates and later updates are given in the source. The case narrative is freely readable as a web page. A licence for reusing the underlying project data is not established. Reported interventions and projected benefits must be distinguished; the case does not supply a ready-to-run simulation. It can inform green-blue infrastructure adaptation scenarios, intervention assumptions and institutional constraints. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
